name: Duolingo, Inc.
blurb: Duolingo is a technology company that develops a mobile learning platform for language education. It is one of the most popular language-learning apps globally, with a freemium model supported by subscriptions and advertising. The company has surpassed $1 billion in revenue and continues to grow its user base, though it faces a competitive edtech landscape.
recent: Duolingo shares rebounded in recent weeks ahead of Q1 2026 earnings due May 4, with analysts expecting revenue of $288.54 million and EPS of $0.79. The stock has gained over 36% year-to-date, recovering from earlier pressures on growth guidance. Focus remains on daily active users and subscription trends.
